results.title: Horrorgirl Mixtape
results.overview: A mixtape celebration of scream queens in all their bloody, sexy glory!!

results.title: For Young People: 20 Years After 2006
results.original_title: Para los jóvenes: a 20 años del 2006
results.overview: Combines archival material with half unpublished images recorded during the election campaign, the post-election conflict and the period of Andrés Manuel López Obrador.

results.title: Alone in the Darkness
results.original_title: អាគារលស់ព្រលឹង
results.overview: After Pol Pot regime,1979, displaced soldiers seeking temporary refuge in an abandoned structure face a new and terrifying enemy. They are trapped and systematically haunted by a fierce female spirit whose deadly mission will not cease until last soldier.

results.title: Jerusalem '67
results.overview: In Jerusalem during the Six Day War, a young civilian leaves her family to serve her country; a man who abhors war must fight within sight of his home; and a group of paratroopers are dispatched to the city for a battle they never trained for.

results.title: Entity
results.overview: When a man in a failing marriage starts receiving texts from an unknown number offering him information about his wife's affair, he'll go to increasing lengths to find out the truth from his mysterious informant, uncovering a web of connected "disciples" along the way.

results.title: A Whole Person Almost
results.overview: Ilias arrives on a remote island to claim his late father’s inheritance. But the longer he is forced to stay on the island, the more his initial indifference begins to fade. As he interacts with the local community, he uncovers his father’s past and, with it, a portrait of a man which differs significantly from his own memories. His gradually awakening emotions are intensified by his encounter with the local girl Kalliopi, by sudden spasms in his body, and by mysterious power outages that affect the entire island.

results.title: Mengejar Zara
results.overview: Despite having zero dating experience, Rafa is determined to do anything to get Zara's attention. Alongside his two equally inexperienced best friends, he embarks on a series of wacky plans to bridge the gap between him and the girl of his dreams. The clock is ticking—can Rafa win her over before the Lebaran break is over?

results.title: ZOE: MEMOREX + REXSEXEX AND MORE
results.overview: A concert film and documentary capturing Zoé's six sold-out nights at the Estadio GNP Seguros in Mexico City. Directed by Rodrigo Guardiola, the movie brings the band's musical journey to the big screen, blending live performances of 27 iconic songs with intimate behind-the-scenes footage, stage production details, and their deep connection with the audience.

results.title: People who can’t read
results.overview: In the quiet of night, a man struggles to lose himself in the pages of a book, yet his dyslexia transforms the words into an labyrinth. Beside him, a stranger reads effortlessly, absorbed in a world the man can only long to enter, leaving him consumed by frustration and envy as even the escape of an audiobook remains beyond his grasp.

results.title: Aponjon
results.overview: A beautiful blend of romance and emotion.

results.title: Camp Salvation
results.overview: What happens when such blasphemous work is discovered at a Christian summer camp??

results.title: Elsewhere at Night
results.overview: A scorching summer stretches across the countryside and the city. In a lush landscape, Marie, a sound artist in research, begins to question her relationship. The arrival of Noée, a young traveler, disrupts her routine and that of Yan, a solitary farmer next door. In the city, Eva, newly arrived from the Philippines, walks sleepless nights, caught between homes, while Jeanne, a master's student, contemplates walking away from everything. Between moments of doubt and brief connections, their worlds echo one another.

results.title: The Bout
results.overview: In Mar Chiquita, Julia goes through a crisis with her boyfriend during their first vacation together. Sergio, the hotel owner and a bohemian ex-boxer, accompanies her in her grief through physical training.

results.title: With Love, Death
results.overview: Death is a weird but likable guy loving art and a good sip of wine. He is very conscientious concerning his work, following "the plan" strictly. One day he finds himself next to a frozen lake, where there is a young woman, Leonie, figure skating. As he realizes that she is going to fall into the ice, he shouts her name and saves her life. He now has to figure out how to deal with it and goes to the bar to convince his friend Tom to help him.
